description: Comprehensive reverse-engineered catalog of Granblue Fantasy HTTP REST endpoints, payload schemas, and headers.

raidInfo.description: Polls active raid HP percentage, member count, and personal contribution honors without triggering turn action.

raidStart.description: Initializes battle state, character HP/meter, status effects, and boss parameters.

normalAttack.description: Executes turn attack; server resolves damage, triggers, status updates, and returns animation scenario.

ability.description: Activates a single character skill/ability. Requires serial dispatch.

requestPayload.target_attribute: string (optional target index for single-target buffs)

summon.description: Invokes main, sub, or supporter summon. Limited to once per turn.

responseSchema.scenario: array of summon cutin & damage frames

guardSetting.description: Toggles V2 battle system Guard state for specified party members.

requestPayload.guard_status: object mapping character index to boolean (0/1)

requestBackup.description: Broadcasts backup assistance request to Everyone (all), Friends, and Crew members.

temporaryItem.description: Consumes raid-only items such as Green Potion, Blue Potion, Clarity Herb, or Revive.

proSkip.description: Instant batch resolution of daily Omega, Impossible, Regalia, and Trials series.

battleKeyCheck.description: Validates and joins a multiplayer raid using an 8-character battle room key.

multiStageList.description: Fetches the list of active multiplayer stage categories and user unlock states.

multiResult.description: Fetches multiplayer battle reward payload: blue chests, gold chests, MVP status, honors, and player rankings.

responseSchema.reward_list: array of drop chest contents with item IDs and quantities

sideStoryList.description: Fetches all archived Side Stories grouped by category along with user completion flags.

sideStoryStage.description: Fetches episodes, story completion state, and free quest stage data for a specific side story.

sideStorySkip.description: Instantly skips all story episodes for a side story, triggering crystal rewards and character unlocks.

sideStoryTrade.description: Executes purchase of Premium Draw Tickets, Half-Elixirs, weapons, or summons in side story treasure shop.
